thread:
mira: Heads-up — noticed a weird RBAC/console rendering issue in staging after the role refactor PR. UI is showing editor controls for some users who should be viewer-only.

mira: Error logs show a KMS decrypt failure when the console tries to fetch role_provenance blob, then it falls back to a permissive path. snippet from logs: `ERROR: kms: decrypt failed: key not found; role_provenance=null -> defaulting to 'editor' in ui_gate()`

alex: Can you repro? which branch/deploy?

mira: Yep repro steps: checkout refactor-perms-2026, deploy to staging, invite a new user to a project using the invite flow, then open console > project settings. Happens about 80% of the time.

jamal: @mira thanks — if KMS decryption fails we should never escalate permissions. That's a bad fallback. We should default to the strictest view (viewer) and log an alert.

anya: Are audit events missing for those sessions? If the UI is giving edit buttons but server rejects save, we need to check telemetry + audit logs for mismatched events.

mira: Audit shows the server-side RPC still enforces editor checks — saves are blocked — but the console allowed the edit UX. So it's a UX gating bug, not an authorization bypass. Still high severity because it exposes controls.

sre-bot: incident-alert: RBAC-UI-PERMISSION-GAP detected in staging. alert_id=stg-2026-09-17-1 priority=high

alex: Quick mitigation: flip feature flag `role_ui_new_gating` to off for staging and rollback the refactor patch there. Also add an immediate hotfix: change ui_gate() fallback to treat unknown provenance as 'viewer'.

jamal: Agreed. I'll open a small PR for the fallback change and a monitoring check to ensure KMS keys used by console exist and have correct aliases.

anya: I'll run a forensic check on audit logs and KMS key rotation history for the last 48h. Need to confirm whether any customer keys were rotated or aliases changed.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of refactor-perms-2026 -> staging at 2026-09-17T14:21Z. 3/5 hosts.

mira: Thanks. Plan: jamal pushes the fallback PR (small, 1-line change), alex flips feature flag, anya reconciles audit + KMS, I’ll run end-to-end repro and attach screenshots. If fallback PR passes code review, we push to staging and then re-enable gating.

alex: Also adding an assertion in the console code: `assert(role_provenance != null) || role_ui_mode == 'strict'` and a telemetry counter `ui.provenance.missing`.

jamal: PR draft: github.com/redwood/refactor-perms/pull/128 (hotfix: strict fallback + telemetry).

mira: Assigning owners: jamal = remediation PR, alex = feature flag flip, anya = audit/KMS, mira = repro + customer impact check.

anya: If audit shows any anomalies, we’ll escalate to compliance and create an H1 incident. will report back in 2 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

mira: Good. tagging @security-oncall for visibility.

sre-bot: ticket created: RBAC_UI_GATING_STAGING_3831234567 (priority: high)

mira: I'll post a short runbook for rollback steps once jamal's PR is up.
